nodes.label: ai-rung predictor (sizeScore → rung)
nodes.rationale: A pure, unit-testable heuristic (fixtures + weighted entrants + courts) rather than regression fitting, because a 12-fixture youth division and a 480-fixture tournament currently cost the same credit while COGS differ by an order of magnitude. Constants shipped UNCALIBRATED with env overrides; calibration is one SQL pass over competition_events bucketing actual output_tokens by pack_units. The server always recomputes at run time — the client's prediction is advisory.

nodes.label: tokenBudgetForCredits (1cr→32K / 2→64K / 3→128K, then flat step)
nodes.rationale: Keys on credits charged rather than the rung, because the joint-run discount max(1, Σ−1) reaches 5, 8, 11 credits and a Record<Rung,…> table cannot key those. Every value is env-overridable so an uncalibrated cliff can be loosened in prod without a deploy.

nodes.label: TokenMeter (budget enforcement in the ladder loop)
nodes.rationale: Enforcement lives in our own ladder loop rather than Anthropic's task_budget beta, because the code-default provider is the OpenRouter cost ladder — provider-agnostic, no beta headers, one code path. Usage is added BEFORE the refusal/parse-failure throws so a round that spent tokens and then failed still counts and a run cannot loop past its cap on failures alone. One meter per run shared across rungs so cross-rung accounting lives in one object.

nodes.label: Hard-budget settlement (no refunds, no true-up)
nodes.rationale: Credits buy a token budget, not usage; price is fixed at confirm time. No schema change and no migration — spendCredit's amount param already exists (hardcoded 1). Failure still releases the hold with no charge, eating COGS of at most ~$2, and margin holds at every rung.

nodes.label: Size-aware MIN_ROUND_RESERVE
nodes.rationale: max(2_000, movableFixtures × 40): a flat 2 000 is wrong for a 200-fixture pack because the assignment list alone is several thousand output tokens, so a round clamped below that truncates, fails to parse, and burns the remaining budget for nothing.

nodes.label: meterStamp / stopped_on_budget / underfunded
nodes.rationale: stopped_on_budget is stamped by the meter and is the only signal separating 'the budget cut this run short' from 'the plan was merely degraded'; underfunded records the user's CHOICE, not the outcome. Without both, the cheaped-out-→-failed analysis cannot be run, so it is stamped on the failure event too.

nodes.label: freeDraftQuote — the zero-token path is not priced from the pack
nodes.rationale: Phase B's empty-instruction run returns the deterministic solver draft with no model call, so it is quoted flat at 1 credit — sizing it would charge a large division 2-3 credits for a run that spends nothing.

nodes.label: Rung confirm card UI
nodes.rationale: Predicted rung is the pre-selected default and the user may adjust up or down; a below-predicted pick warns 'may stop before a full schedule' and stamps underfunded. Copy states only what the meter actually enforces: credits buy a thinking budget up to X tokens.

hyperedges.label: Token-weighted AI pricing flow: predict → quote → budget → meter → stamp
